title: Portfolio Layout
content: Create portfolio/showcase layout for projects. Hero: personal intro with name, title, brief bio, social links. Project grid: responsive grid with project cards. Card: project thumbnail with hover overlay, title, description, tech tags. Filter bar: filter by category/technology. Hover effect: overlay with "View Project" button. Project detail: modal or separate page with full description, image gallery. About section: skills list, experience timeline. Contact section.

variants.simple: Create portfolio page with project grid, filters, and about section.
variants.detailed: Create portfolio/showcase layout for projects. Hero: personal intro with name, title, brief bio, social links. Project grid: responsive grid with project cards. Card: project thumbnail with hover overlay, title, description, tech tags. Filter bar: filter by category/technology. Hover effect: overlay with "View Project" button. Project detail: modal or separate page with full description, image gallery. About section: skills list, experience timeline. Contact section.
variants.advanced: Create portfolio/showcase layout for projects with filtering and modals. Hero section: py-20 text-center or asymmetric layout. Content: personal intro with name (text-4xl font-bold), title/role (text-xl text-gray-600), brief bio paragraph, social links row (GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter icons), "View Work" and "Contact" CTAs. Optional: animated avatar or illustration. Project section: py-16. Section title "Selected Work" or "Projects". Filter bar: horizontal buttons/pills for categories (All, Web, Mobile, Design), active state (bg-black text-white), click filters projects with animation. Project grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Project card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg. Thumbnail: aspect-video object-cover, grayscale or brightness filter on hover. Hover overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-black/70 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity, flex items-center justify-center, "View Project" button and external link icon. Card content below: title (font-semibold), brief description (text-sm text-gray-600), tech tags (flex flex-wrap gap-2, small pills). Project detail: modal (or route /project/[slug]) with close button, full description, my role, technologies used (icons or tags), image gallery (grid or carousel with lightbox), live demo link and code repository link buttons. Gallery: multiple images in grid, click opens lightbox viewer with navigation. About section: two columns (text + photo or skills). Longer bio, skills list grouped by category (Frontend, Backend, Tools) with proficiency bars optional, experience timeline (vertical with dates, company, role, description). Contact section: "Get in touch" heading, contact form (name, email, message) or email CTA button, location if relevant. Responsive: cards adjust grid-cols-3 to 2 to 1. Animation: subtle entrance animations on scroll (fade-up). Dark mode friendly with appropriate contrast. External links in footer: GitHub, LinkedIn, resume/CV download button. Mobile navigation: hamburger menu.
